subject.title: fix(install): bound curl connection setup with --connect-timeout 20

question: Should the public curl installer adopt a 20-second per-attempt connection-setup cutoff, matching the existing wget timeout policy, even though unusually slow connection establishment will now fail instead of waiting indefinitely?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but choosing a public failure cutoff for installers is an upgrade-sensitive availability policy that code inspection and tests cannot decide on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Accept wget-parity cutoff
options.body: Merge the 20-second curl connection timeout, preserving the existing transfer grace window and retries while bounding otherwise indefinite connection setup.

options.title: Choose a different timeout policy
options.body: Ask for a revised timeout or a documented rationale if the 20-second value is not appropriate for supported installer environments.

options.title: Keep current curl behavior
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers prefer no connection-establishment cutoff for curl users.

recommendation.title: Accept wget-parity cutoff
recommendation.body: Merge the 20-second curl connection timeout, preserving the existing transfer grace window and retries while bounding otherwise indefinite connection setup.
